acceptance: The exact call, tractable version and full error text with its recovery list are quoted in the closing note.
It is stated whether the message comes from tractable or from evals/ablation/tracker.py.
If still misleading: an upstream issue or a tracker item in the tractable project exists and is linked; or, for the stand-in, a PR with a test and a dated amendment is merged.
The phase 3 report's limit is updated with a dated note pointing to the outcome.
description: Problem: the phase 3 report lists a confound, equal across arms: when take or finish hits a not_before hold, the tracker server's error message suggests the wrong recovery action. It may steer agents in real sessions to clear or work around a hold. The exact message and call were not recorded in the report. Outcome: the message reproduced and quoted, and the defect reported where the tracker is maintained. Decision gate: if the current tractable version no longer shows a misleading recovery hint, close with the quoted current message. If it does, file it upstream; fix it here only if the fault is in evals/ablation/tracker.py (the test stand-in) and not in tractable itself. Guardrails: reproduce against a throwaway store or the test stand-in, never by setting or clearing a hold on a real item in this tracker; do not change the todo skill's guidance in this item; a fix to the stand-in changes scenario behaviour, so it needs a dated amendment and must not be applied while phase 3 results are being pooled with new runs.
